attchmntText: Vardhman Polytex Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Vardhman Polytex Limited board approved un-audited financial results for the half year ended 30 September 2026. The meeting was held on 12 November 2026. Total assets stood at 29,844.05 lakhs compared to 28,313.19 lakhs previously. Total equity was 13,855.50 lakhs versus negative 19,718.10 lakhs. Net cash used in operating activities was 4,208.69 lakhs. Net cash from investing activities was 100.22 lakhs. Net cash from financing activities was 4,124.04 lakhs. Cash and cash equivalents closed at 43.78 lakhs. The company submitted security cover disclosures under Regulation 54.

attchmntText: Vardhman Polytex Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates- Intimation regarding amicable settlement with operational creditor
voiceSummary: Vardhman Polytex Limited has informed the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited on November 12, 2026, regarding an amicable settlement with M/s. Bhagwati Cotton Company. This disclosure is under Regulation 30 and 51 of SEBI LODR, 2015. The settlement resolves outstanding dues that were the subject of an application filed by Bhagwati Cotton Company under Section 9 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The earlier intimation regarding this application was dated 29th October, 2026. The proceedings were pending before the National Company Law Tribunal, Chandigarh Bench. The company states it will take necessary steps according to the mutual understanding. Vardhman Polytex Limited will keep the stock exchanges updated on further material developments as they arise.
